unit_attributes.scope_text: When a storm warning is active and an agency officer authorizes an outdoor demonstration for the duration of the current warning.
unit_attributes.statement: An authorization granted by an agency officer for an outdoor demonstration during an active storm warning expires when that warning ends, and it does not authorize demonstrations under a later warning.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For displays held entirely before sunset.
unit_attributes.statement: For displays held entirely before sunset, the organizer should place a readable map near the entrance.

unit_attributes.scope_text: For displays held entirely before sunset where the organizer is recommended to place a readable map near the entrance.
unit_attributes.statement: The recommendation for the organizer to place a readable map near the entrance for displays held entirely before sunset does not create a duty to illuminate exits after sunset.

unit_attributes.choice_text: Weekends and holidays count toward the 30 calendar days.
unit_attributes.statement: The organizer must retain each inspection record for at least 30 calendar days after the display closes, with weekends and holidays counting toward the 30 days.

unit_attributes.scope_text: After the display closes, if an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day retention period ends.
unit_attributes.statement: If an investigation is open when the 30-calendar-day retention period ends after the display closes, the organizer must retain the inspection record until the agency closes the investigation.
Visitors are not required to supply their home addresses.
This policy does not prohibit visitors from bringing paper maps, but other premises rules may restrict particular materials.
A queue may form when several groups arrive together.
